name: Saimin
source:
Main character enters a university after a year of ronin study. He starts going out with a girl living in the next room. But everything changes when he meets a fortune teller in the town...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-september-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公经过一年浪人学习后进入大学。他开始与住在隔壁房间的女孩交往。然而，当他在城里遇见算命师时，一切都发生了变化……

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-september-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
